concerns.text: FR-014 requires `edge_spectrum.json` to contain fields `model_pairs` and `similarity_matrix`, but `edge_spectrum.schema.yaml` (referenced in FR-013) defines only `model_name`, `top_k`, `edge_vectors`, `checksum`, and `generated_at`. This mismatch makes it impossible to verify compliance with both the functional requirement and the JSON‑Schema contract.

FR-008 states the shared subword vocabulary must be "of a size on the order of ten thousand". The phrase "on the order of" is vague and does not give a concrete, testable bound (e.g., 9,500–11,500). Without a precise numeric range the requirement cannot be automatically verified.

FR-028 mandates "paired‑architecture control analyses" and reporting "adjusted similarity metrics" that isolate linguistic effects, but it does not specify how the adjustment is computed (e.g., statistical model, covariate regression, or subtraction of baseline). The lack of a concrete procedure makes the requirement untestable.

FR-010 requires the system to compute "adjusted similarity metrics" to isolate linguistic effects, yet the specification provides no algorithmic definition or measurable threshold for what constitutes an "adjusted" metric, rendering verification impossible.
